legacySurfaces.note: Legacy gamification counters directly consume memberships and events; posts are part of the same browser prototype state but are not observed as a direct G2 reward source.

cutoverRules: No G2 backend service may read localStorage or any breiz-* legacy browser key.
Legacy counters, badges, levels and challenges are not G2 progression authority.
Legacy browser state must never be converted directly into World resources.
Any migration of an eligible Owner action requires canonical server-side source verification for the exact Owner and event kind.
A migration must be idempotent and must not double-reward an action already present in world_progression_events.
Legacy key deletion requires an explicit product/data-handling decision and must not happen silently.
Until cutover is explicitly approved, legacy browser state and G2 durable state remain separate authorities, with G2 production writes still inactive.
promotionRequirements: choose RETIRE, MIGRATE or EXCLUDE for each legacy surface
define Owner-visible handling for legacy browser state before deletion
prove G2 backend has no dependency on localStorage or breiz-* keys
if migration is chosen, define canonical source mapping and anti-double-reward rules
reconcile non-SQL erasure inventory with the chosen treatment
keep dog/Care/ELI-derived legacy metrics outside G2 reward authority
